# Weyland-Yutani Corporate Handbook
[color=#a4885c]DRAFT: under review by staff. Subject to change.[/color]
This handbook covers Weyland-Yutani personnel planetside: who answers to whom, what each terminal does, and how the corporation does business with the colony.
Weyland-Yutani is a guest on the colony's land. It pays rent, holds licences the colony can revoke, and can lend the colony money. The colony needs corporate money, and the corporation needs the colony's goodwill. Most corporate play comes down to managing that relationship.
